top_signals.title: Upbit trading volume spikes 273% as South Korean investors re-enter crypto
top_signals.summary: One analyst said South Korean capital is slowly moving back to crypto, as investors are 'return-chasing' rather than 'asset-loyal.'
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
